He then announces there is a bigger item on auction and reveals William Rhodes is really Batman, who is beginning to feel the effects of the poisonous gas since his mask was sabotaged. The Dealer tells the crowd to tear Batman apart.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #873
issues.synopsis:
Batman fights his way out of Mirror House with the crowbar the Joker beat Robin to death with. He hallucinates that he woke up, having lost his legs in the attack, and Barbara Gordon attacked him with a knife, before he wakes up nine hours later, unharmed but still working through the effects of the gas. Barbara tells Dick she is still digging through the Dealer's finances and will soon have him dead to rights, no matter where he goes, but Dick wants to catch him in Gotham.

The Dealer takes off in the Redfords' private plane, but Batman pursues in the Batplane. He captures the Dealer, but the Dealer transforms into a giant bat-like creature. He tells Batman he's a hallucination, but Batman saw the syringes and knows he took some combination of Venom and the Man-Bat serum. Before Batman can deliver the Dealer to the authorities, he is knocked out of the plane's cargo hold.

Dick redecorates the penthouse with his things since Leslie Thompkins believes “psychological anchors” will help combat the effects of the nightmare gas. The Redford plane was recovered from the river, but no bodies were found. Dick reflects on how dark Gotham has become before telling Alfred to toss the crowbar into the river.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #874
issues.synopsis:
Commissioner Gordon confronts his son about what happened at the aviary. James, Jr , apologizes to Gordon for the harm he's done, and he explains he has been diagnosed as a psychopath and is now taking Diaxamyne to manage it. He has applied to work with Leslie Thompkins , to help people like him, and he asks Gordon to put in a good word with the Waynes so they don't block his hiring.

Three days later, Red Robin warns Batman that he is still under the effects of the Dealer 's nightmare gas. Batman changes the subject because he's spotted the poachers who are stealing the birds freed from the aviary. He opens the compartment of the poachers' boat and sees a crowd of orange eyes. A voice tells him they're going to eat him up until there's nothing left. A poacher knocks him off the boat, and he sees a killer whale coming to devour him. Red Robin pulls him out of the water and shows him all the endangered species aboard the ship. They speculate that someone new is behind this.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #875

info.Editors: Mike Marts Janelle Asselin Katie Kubert

issues.synopsis: Jim Gordon hunts down a man named Roy Blount he believes to be the Peter Pan Killer, a child murderer he chased in his early days. Still dealing with the return of his son, James, Jr. , he remembers the day James Jr. was accused of murdering a girl named Bess Keller. Bess had been one of Barbara 's friends, and she disappeared in the woods while they were on vacation. Barbara claims to have seen James, Jr. carrying Bess' keychain but this was never proven. When Gordon finally takes down Blount, Blount implies that he murdered Keller in an act of revenge. Batman appears to take care of the criminal, and confirms that James Jr. was also not responsible for the birds being released.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #876

info.Editors: Mike Marts Katie Kubert Janelle Asselin

issues.synopsis:
Commissioner Gordon uses the Wayne crime labs again when a dead killer whale is found in the middle of a large Gotham bank run by Tony Zucco 's daughter. Gordon wanted to tell Dick Grayson about the connection, but despite Dick's suspicions, Sonia Zucco is clean. They muse on how rare it is for children to break from their parents' example, and Gordon tells Dick that James, Jr , wants to meet him. He wants Dick to promise to tell him his honest impression of James, Jr, after meeting him, just as a woman's corpse falls out of the killer whale.

The woman is Evelyn Marr, Sonia's personal assistant. Sonia refuses to tell Batman anything because she has other people close to her that “they'll” come after. Batman leaves behind a bug when he goes, and he hears her make a phone call to somebody, promising to do whatever they want if they stop hurting people. Batman traces the call to Bixby Rhodes , a car dealer turned gun smuggler. He goes to Rhodes's car dealership where goons fire at him, driving him to shelter in a car crusher that Rhodes activates.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #877

info.Editors: Mike Marts Katie Kubert Janelle Asselin

issues.synopsis:
Batman escapes the car crusher. Bixby Rhodes, also called “the Roadrunner,” takes off, bounding on mechanical legs, but he is caught in the cable of Batman's grappling gun. Batman asks why he is after Sonia Branch, and when the Roadrunner won't say why, Batman breaks his mechanical legs and drags him to the Batmobile; however, Gordon tells Batman they won't be able to hold the Roadrunner because Batman was trespassing and the crusher destroyed the evidence.

Batman and Gordon don't understand the connection between the dead killer whale and the Roadrunner, and Batman remains suspicious of Sonia Branch. Sonia admits she was scared of Batman due to her family history and hid that criminals have approached her bank to launder their money. Two were particularly insistent: the Roadrunner and a smuggler called “Tiger Shark.”

Batman investigates the old gas pipeline, which he correctly suspected was how Tiger Shark got the killer whale into Gotham. He is cornered underwater by Tiger Shark's armed ship with more killer whales inside.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #878

info.Editors: Katie Kubert Janelle Asselin Mike Marts

issues.synopsis:
Batman is held above the killer whale tank aboard Tiger Shark 's ship. Batman frees himself. He chases Tiger Shark, but he escapes and blasts a hole in the yacht as he goes that will flood the ship in less than a minute.

Batman makes it to the surface in time to meet James Gordon, Jr . They reminisce about a boy they knew twelve years ago who had bullied James, Jr, and while talking about how Ben Wolff changed, Dick realizes Sonia Branch hasn't.

Batman accuses Sonia of destroying the security footage of Tiger Shark's henchmen planting the killer whale inside the bank. She wanted to hide Tiger Shark's involvement so that he would take out Roadrunner before Tiger Shark, and she defends herself, saying they were criminals who threatened her. Batman says the delay led to Tiger Shark's escape, and she argues he escaped because Batman failed to catch him. Batman calls her “Ms. Zucco.”

James, Jr, meanwhile, is at Ben Wolff's house where he is torturing Ben in the basement.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #879

info.Editors: Mike Marts Janelle Asselin Katie Kubert

issues.synopsis:
Commissioner Gordon visits Leslie Thompkins at her clinic, and she tells him about how helpful James Jr. has been. He's even volunteering to do the nutrition runs, bringing baby formula from the manufacturer to new parents. But Gordon remains suspicious of his son's new leaf and asks Babs to analyze the new drug that James Jr. has been taking. Barbara discovers the Diamaxyne has been altered to do the reverse of what it should, and while it is too weak to affect an adult, it could turn a child who ingested it into a psychopath.

Gordon realizes that is why James volunteered to make the nutrition runs. Gordon goes to his son's apartment to confront him, but James isn't there. Gordon finds a box full of keys from James's past victims, including the bat key chain owned by Barbara's friend Bess Keller who went missing fifteen years ago. Harvey Bullock tells him the Joker has escaped.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #880

info.Editors: Mike Marts Janelle Asselin Katie Kubert

issues.synopsis:
Commissioner Gordon calls his ex-wife Barbara Eileen and tells her he alerted hotel security to the Joker's escape, but she should stay in her hotel room until he arrives. She hears a knock at the door and assumes it's hotel security, but screams. Gordon runs up the hotel stairs and finds Barbara Eileen Jokerized. She is brought to the Wayne Enterprises lab for treatment.

Batman investigates the Joker 's escape from Arkham Asylum with Harvey Bullock . The Joker used the same Joker Venom in his escape as he used on Barbara Eileen, and not only is it one of his oldest formula, it would have had to have been smuggled to him in his food. Batman follows the Joker's trail through the sewers and finds him in the crypt of a church. The Joker denies attacking Barbara Eileen, and Batman realizes who the true culprit must have been. Barbara Eileen wakes up and tells Gordon it was “him.” Oracle sees her brother in the security footage as James Jr. attacks her from behind.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #881

info.Editors: Mike Marts Janelle Asselin Katie Kubert

issues.synopsis:
Barbara Gordon 's wheelchair is found outside the Kord Needle, covered in Barbara's blood. James Jr. shows Barbara he stabbed her with a knife in each leg, each in her femoral arteries, so if she pulls either out, she'll bleed to death.

James Jr. tells Barbara that when Commissioner Gordon put him in Arkham Asylum to scare him straight, he was a few cells down from the Joker, but Barbara doubts James Jr. planted the idea to shoot her. He admits he didn't. Barbara says she never thought he'd monologue like all the other villains in Gotham, and in retaliation, James Jr. pulls out one of the knives. James Jr. says this isn't about her, it's about him.

James Jr. contacts Batman , calling him “Dick.” He tells Batman the Diaxamyne did work, but the clinical trial convinced him that as a psychopath he was a more evolved human; however, he couldn't go on as he had hurting people forever before he got caught. Then he recognized Dick Grayson as Batman. He returned to Gotham, convincing the teen boys to free the birds from the aviary and buying the old Joker Venom from the Dealer . He saved Batman at Mirror House , dragging him to the alley where he was found by Red Robin . He bribed an Arkham guard to deliver the venom to the Joker while he framed the villain for the attack on his mother . He plans to kill Barbara, then Commissioner Gordon, because he believes Dick's compassion makes him so weak he will give up if they're killed, and no one will know whether he tainted the baby formula for another twenty years.

As he spoke, Barbara escaped and hid, and when James Jr. finds her, she punches him. He is momentarily stunned before giving chase. He has her cornered, but Batman comes up from behind and knocks him away. He tells Barbara he planted a tracker on James Jr. when they met for lunch. He might be soft, but he isn't stupid. Gordon shoots James Jr. in the leg as he tries to escape, causing him to fall off a bridge, but Gordon catches him and refuses to let go.

Wayne Enterprises dismantles the crime lab because the GCPD refused to use it. Dick tells Gordon they tested the baby formula vats, but the results were inconclusive; if James Jr. did taint the formula, he did it long ago, but Dick thinks that if he had, there would still be trace amounts in the vats. Below them, a baby passing by in their stroller stares blankly ahead.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #934
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part 1: The Young and the Brave"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Dave Wielgosz Chris Conroy Mark Doyle

issues.synopsis:
In Gotham City, Azrael clutches his shoulder standing at the window of a church, having been attacked. He looks up at a silhouetted figure with pointed ears. The figure lunges forward, sending Azrael through the church window and landing hard on the church's floor. Azrael tells the figure that he has no intentions of giving up seeing as he believes he serves a higher power. The figure is undeterred by this and a brutal battle ensues. Azrael gets a few good hits in before the figure ultimately gains the upper hand, electrocuting Azrael. The figure does not have the chance to end Azrael's life before being radioed that Batman is approaching.

Batman arrives at the scene, finding Azrael still alive. Batman asks Azrael who attacked him and Azrael tells him that he did.

Later, Kate Kane , aka Batwoman, is having a conversation with her father, Colonel Jacob Kane about her future. He wants her to stop going out as Batwoman and taking down the few criminals Batman does not get to first, instead suggesting that she and him talk about her military future. She ends the conversation and deactivates her comms before realising that there is someone in her apartment.

Turning around she sees that it is Batman. He shows her a small drone that he recovered from the Church where he found Azrael. He explains that the technology is a decade ahead of the highest grade military technology. He was able to access the network it was on and reveals that the drone was a part of a swarm that has been spying on Gotham's various vigilantes who he himself as also been keeping tabs on.

He intends to properly train Gotham's vigilantes as a new crime fighting force in the wake of his recent discovery and asks her to be a member. He tells her that her background in the military makes her perfect for creating an efficient unit of crime fighters as although they have each shown potential, they still require improved training to handle the force that is coming for them.

Batwoman voices her confusion as to why Batman would be so quick to trust her, prompting Batman to remove his mask and reveal himself as her cousin Bruce. She responds to the supposedly great revelation by admitting she had known for a while and had been waiting for him to admit it.

Some time later, at the Bay Street Seaport, a group of thugs on the Penguin 's complain about how their current robbery plan should have been full proof as the GCPD arrives at the warehouse they are held up in. The vigilante Stephanie Brown aka Spoiler speaks up from the rafters, revealing that she hacked the leader's phone and leaked the contents to the cops. The thugs open fire on Spoiler, allowing for a hidden Tim Drake , aka Red Robin, to get the drop on them making the fight a short ordeal.

At the end of the fight, Tim reveals that he got a letter back, prompting excitement from Stephanie whereas Tim remains unsure as to what he will do next. Unbeknownst to them, a drone similar to the one Batman showed Batwoman watches them. The moment is undercut by the arrival of Batman and Batwoman who say they have plans for them.

A short time later, a group of armed men surround four children all huddled together in a condemned building. One of the men remarks that the kids are going to be shipped all around the country. They do not get a chance to grab the kids before Cassandra Cain , aka Orphan, bursts down through the ceiling to block their path. She quickly dispatches each of them, leaving the final one begging for mercy before Batman and Batwoman intervene to tell Orphan that they have work to do.

A few nights later, Basil Karlo aka Clayface sits alone in a Gotham theatre watching one of his old movies, having scared off the audience. He is approached by Batman and Batwoman who he is not pleased to see.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #935
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part 2: Apocalypse Now"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batwoman puts Clayface, Orphan, Red Robin, and Spoiler through intense training in the Mud Room. She breaks down each team member's performance highlighting something that each of them needs to improve before she can take them out on patrol.

Red Robin questions Batman about why they are being kept off the table while they visit a bedridden Azrael in his hideout. Azrael informs Batman and Red Robin that the Colony is here.

Stephanie Brown and Tim Drake discuss his opportunity to attend Ivy University on a Genius Grant. She is frustrated that Tim has yet to discuss the option with Bruce.

Kate Kane argues with her father, Jacob Kane, about her choice to work with Batman as opposed to working with him.

Batman is attacked by two armored vehicles while driving the Batmobile. The vehicles were invisible to his sensors and the Batmobile was completely immobilized by a blast from an electrical cannon.

Batman is confronted by fifty Colony soldiers resembling his appearance.

Other Characters: Alfred Pennyworth (On a TV or computer screen)

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #936
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part 3: Army of Shadows"

info.Cover Artists: Álvaro Martínez Bueno Raúl Fernández Tomeu Morey
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Kate Kane meets Renee Montoya at a bar, reflecting on her past experiences in boot camp and beginning to question her leadership abilities. Renee, with a touch of exasperation, urges Kate to trust herself and embrace the leader she has always been. As Renee leaves, Kate receives a call from Red Robin, summoning her to the Belfry.

At the Belfry, Red Robin shows Batwoman footage of Batman being defeated by the Colony. Recognizing the urgency, Batwoman calls the team together, even reaching out to her estranged father, Colonel Kane. Everyone responds except Orphan, who has already been ambushed by the Colony on the Belfry's rooftop.

Colonel Kane reveals himself as the leader of the Colony and disables the Belfry's defenses, allowing his forces to invade. He confronts Kate, explaining that while Batman is powerful, his efforts are misguided. Kane insists there is a war of unprecedented scale, one that Batman cannot fully grasp—and it has arrived in Gotham.

Despite his plea, Batwoman and the team reject Colonel Kane's offer to join the Colony. As chaos erupts, Clayface shields the team, enabling their escape into Gotham's underground tunnels.

Other Characters: Batman (On a TV or computer screen)

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #937
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part Four: The Great Escape"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Two Colony soldiers guarding Batman are cataloging the items from his Utility Belt when Batman uses a hidden smoke grenade concealed in his tooth to stage an escape. In the ensuing chaos, he overpowers the guards and discovers he has been imprisoned in The Cave, the Colony's central base of operations.

Meanwhile, in the tunnels, Red Robin leads the team to an abandoned underground train station retrofitted to house several Bat-Trains. During the Colony's invasion, Red Robin managed to briefly hack their network and pinpoint Batman's location.

In The Cave, Batman confronts Ulysses Hadrian Armstrong, a prodigy who has been reverse-engineering Bat-Tech for the Colony since his teens. Ulysses explains the Colony's vision: to replicate Batman's methods by equipping soldiers trained in his style with his technology, using them to neutralize terrorist threats. To illustrate, Ulysses shows Batman footage of a Colony raid. The use of lethal force in the operation horrifies Batman, as it stands in direct opposition to his code.

Their tense exchange is interrupted by Colonel Kane, who accuses Bruce of failing his mission and being unprepared to confront the League of Shadows. Batman dismisses the League of Shadows as a mere myth propagated to intimidate Ra's al Ghul's followers.

As Colonel Kane holds a gun to Batman's head, Batwoman bursts into the room, declaring her allegiance to Batman. The rest of the team arrives in time, launching an all-out attack to turn the tide.

Other Characters: Killer Croc (On a TV or computer screen)
Professor Pyg (On a TV or computer screen)

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #938
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part Five: Enemy at the Gates"

info.Cover Artists: Álvaro Martínez Bueno Raúl Fernández Tomeu Morey
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
In a flashback, Colonel Kane attends a top-secret briefing that marks the inception of the Colony. Midway through, his pager buzzes with the news that his daughter, Kate, has been found. He rushes to her location and discovers a young Kate at her mother's grave. The two share a heartfelt conversation about their grief, and Kate reveals her desire to become a soldier and fight alongside him.

Flashing forward to the present, Batman and his team launch their assault on the Colony's hideout. Batman and Batwoman coordinate the mission: Clayface is tasked with clearing a path to the upper floors, Red Robin is sent to disable the computer systems, and Orphan is assigned to secure the upper deck.

Red Robin confronts Ulysses Hadrian Armstrong, who reveals the Colony's computer is tracking a significant number of targets across Gotham. Before Red Robin can stop him, Ulysses escapes, leaving Red Robin to face a squad of Colony soldiers. Spoiler, working remotely, triggers their grenades to detonate, saving Red Robin.

The team advances to the upper levels with the help of Clayface, who transforms into an organic bridge. Colonel Kane shoots off Batwoman's mask, exposing her face. He offers her one last chance to join the Colony and abandon Batman, but she refuses. In response, Colonel Kane orders his troops to attack, only to discover Red Robin has already hacked their helmet communications, rendering them incapacitated.

As the team retreats, Colonel Kane and Ulysses regroup to expedite their plan. Ulysses unveils an army of aerial drones designed to eliminate their targets across Gotham. Despite the risk to innocent lives, Colonel Kane agrees, believing the collateral damage is an acceptable price to eradicate the League of Shadows and their perceived threat.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #939
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part Six: The Thin Red Line"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
The issue starts with a flashback to the funeral of Martha and Thomas Wayne. Jacob Kane criticizes Thomas's choice to go down the alleyway and mourns his sister. Kate joins Bruce, who is sitting alone, and comforts him.

In the present day, Tim Drake decides to take the Genius Grant he has been offered, but hesitates to tell Bruce the news. Kate confronts Bruce and he admits he knew it was her father behind the drones all along. Bruce reports the actions of Jacob Kane to the President in a phone call.

Tim discovers the fleet of weaponized drones that Ulysses has sent out to Gotham. The Bat-team rushes to evacuate civillians. Tim reprograms the drones to switch targets--to himself.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #940
issues.story: " Rise of the Batmen , Part Seven: The Red Badge of Courage"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Jacob Kane learns that Tim Drake has redirected all the drones to attack himself instead of the citizens of Gotham. He demands that Ulysses reroutes the drones to their original targets, but Ulysses is unable to do so.

Kate Kane arrives to confront her father. She punches her father and informs him that this branch of the military is now wanted for domestic terror. As the US military comes to collect, Jacob teleports his people away--but not before Kate launches the two of them out a window.

Tim Drake is singlehandedly trying to fight off the drone attacks. He has successfully fought off the first round when Batman arrives. Tim then sees the second round of drones. He tells Bruce to send his regards to the BatFam. Then he calls Stephanie Brown for a final farewell. The drones arrive and take him out.

Bruce tells Kate to take her father to the Belfry instead of turning him in to the military. Meanwhile, Spoiler is grieving the loss of Tim. Batman visits her to ensure her safety, and she shows him Tim's Genius Grant offer letter. He and Stephanie embrace.

We see Tim appear in an unknown location. A mysterious hooded figure greets him and says he has been "taken off the field." Tim insists his friends will come for him as the hooded figure walks away.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #941
issues.story: " Night of the Monster Men , Part 3"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batwoman asks everyone for a report. Spoiler mentions the little space they have at the evacuation site and tells Batwoman that their connection is breaking up. Nightwing is nearly to Blackgate. Alfred mentions that neither he nor Duke are chemists and that Tim would have had this figured out by now. Clayface is having a hard time holding his many forms together. Gotham Girl is at Blackgate against Batman's wishes.

Tensions are rising between the citizens with Spoiler and Orphan. A little boy looking for his parents (Mama Jill and Mama Liz) is pushed over by an angry citizen.

Nightwing arrives at Blackgate; Batman tells him that he has to get Gotham Girl out of there due to her being emotionally compromised still from the attack by Psycho Pirate. Creatures are attacking inmates and latching onto their faces.

Batman, Batwoman, and Clayface are in the streets. Part of a building starts falling over some citizens; Clayface, shape-shifted as a cop, pushes them out of the way and the building part lands on him. The citizens are at first grateful, then scared when they see Clayface shifting, but are distracted by the giant monster attacking the city.

Back in the cave, Spoiler and Orphan decide to split up to help the outnumbered cops keep order in the escalating angry mob. Spoiler tries to contact Batwoman to update her on the situation, but is unable to make contact due to too much static. Batman, still reeling from the death of Red Robin, is worried about Spoiler and Orphan and wants to go to the cave to see what they can't be contacted. Batwoman tells him that he's needed where he is, and that he should trust Spoiler. Meanwhile, Spoiler and Orphan figure out that the sludge covering the people must be communicating and acting as one giant organism. They figure out that if they get the air hot enough in the cave, it should be able to stop the air-borne plant volatiles (and thus the communication) so that they can get the people out of there.

Back at Blackgate, Nightwing points out to Gotham Girl that as she's fighting the monsters, she's also hurting people. Gotham Girl runs into the mama monster. Nightwing tries to stop her, but she rips the mama apart in a rage. Blood and parts from the monster cover Nightwing and Gotham Girl; it transforms them into monsters.

Batwoman tries to contact everyone, but only Batman and Clayface respond.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #942
issues.story: " Night of the Monster Men , Finale"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batman places Batwoman in charge of the superheroes fighting the newly mutated monster on the ground, while he heads to Anders Tower to face Strange.

Batwoman, Nightwing, Spoiler, and Orphan each man one of the watchtowers.

Meanwhile, at Anders Tower, Batman enters to find Strange still wearing a Batsuit, sitting on a throne of psychology textbooks. He reveals that the suit is a "suicide suit" triggered by touch. Strange claims that he is the only one able to face the madness of Gotham City and stay sane, and believes the only way to do so is to take on the mantle of Batman.

Nightwing deduces what the fifth monster is meant to represent and goes to confront the monster alone.

Strange baits Batman, saying that he keeps losing his sidekicks because he is unfit for the job. Batman is able to subdue Strange by sealing the room using Clayface as the walls, blocking Strange's ability to breathe.

Nightwing reveals that Strange believed Batman's biggest fault to be ego, driven by a child's mind, manifesting in a child as the source inside the monster.

In an epilogue set a few days later, a news report says the city is being cleaned up by GCPD in cooperation with the superheroes and holds it as a testament to Gotham's resilience against monsters.

Kate and Bruce stand in front of four fresh graves for Strange's four victims. Strange is in custody and Bruce makes clear his intent to target Bane next, as the formula originated from him.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #943
issues.story: " The Victim Syndicate , Part One: I Saw the Devil"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batwoman and Renee Montoya stand in front of a vandalized Wayne Enterprises sign. The sign, painted in red to say "No More" alongside the Bat-logo, sets a grim tone. Reviewing security footage, they observe Lucius Fox entering Wayne Enterprises and encountering a mysterious group exiting an elevator. A security team intervenes but is immediately killed by what appears to be poison.

Meanwhile, Batman interrogates Colonel Jacob Kane but gains no useful information. Batwoman updates Batman about the events at Wayne Enterprises, and they briefly discuss Spoiler's absence since Tim Drake's presumed death.

Stephanie Brown voices her concerns to Harper Row, lamenting how their efforts to help often lead to more harm. Harper reveals that this is one reason she retired her Bluebird costume and now focuses on working at the Thompkins Free Clinic.

In the Mud Room, Orphan and Clayface practice fighting simulated villains. After a successful round, Clayface requests the Batcomputer to generate “the biggest, ugliest bad guy.” To his dismay, the system produces a grotesquely oversized version of himself, forcing Clayface to confront his fear of being nothing more than a monster.

Later, Bruce Wayne and Kate Kane attend a gala and argue about Bruce's reluctance to discuss Tim's fate and its impact on the team. Kate suggests they bring someone in to continue Tim's work in the Belfry. Bruce agrees, revealing that meeting Luke Fox is one of the reasons they are at the event.

Stephanie and Harper also attend the gala and meet Cassandra Cain, who has brought Basil Karlo in his human form. As Bruce and Kate debate the decision to include Luke, an explosion rocks the venue.

The same five individuals from the security footage appear, identifying themselves as the Victim Syndicate. They accuse Batman of ruining their lives and declare their intent to exact revenge.

Other Characters: Gotham City Police Department (On a TV or computer screen)
Wayne Enterprises (On a TV or computer screen)
Lucius Fox (On a TV or computer screen)

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #944
issues.story: " The Victim Syndicate , Part Two: Payback"

info.Cover Artists: Álvaro Martínez Bueno Raúl Fernández Brad Anderson
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Stephanie Brown, Cassandra Cain, Harper Row, and Basil Karlo sneak into the gala's garage to get a closer look at Luke Fox's flying car. As they approach, the vehicle activates, and pieces of Batwing's suit eject, assembling around Luke as he leaps off the building, fully suited.

Meanwhile, Batman and the team engage the Victim Syndicate, but their attempts to fight are thwarted by strange abilities. Mr. Noxious poisons Spoiler, The Mute silences Batman, and First Victim addresses the crowd, claiming they fight for the innocent victims harmed by Gotham's costumed vigilantes.

Batwing manages to cut the Syndicate's broadcast feed and disables First Victim's shield long enough for Batman to attack. Orphan defeats Mr. Noxious, and Batwoman subdues The Mute. As Basil and Harper evacuate Spoiler, they are met by Mudface, who confronts Basil.

Madame Crow paralyzes Batman with an injection and releases an anti-fear toxin on the armed officers at the gala. Stripped of their inhibitions, the officers begin shooting indiscriminately, injuring innocent bystanders in the chaos. Amid the confusion, the Victim Syndicate escapes.

Back at the Belfry, Batman, Batwoman, and Luke Fox investigate the origins of the Victim Syndicate. While they have no information on the First Victim, they learn that The Mute was exposed to Joker's laughing gas, requiring a tracheotomy to survive. Madame Crow was one of Scarecrow's students and subjected to horrific experiments as one of his first test subjects. Mr. Noxious was briefly under Poison Ivy's control, leaving him toxic to anyone nearby. Mudface is Glory Griffin, a production assistant on Basil Karlo's final film, who was exposed to the same chemicals that transformed Basil into Clayface.

Batman visits Spoiler at the Thompkins Free Clinic to check on her recovery, but Dr. Leslie Thompkins prevents him from seeing her. Frustrated, Leslie admonishes Batman for repeatedly putting young people in harm's way.

The First Victim appears in Stephanie's room, ominously stating that it's time for a conversation.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #945
issues.story: " The Victim Syndicate , Part Three: Unforgiven"

info.Cover Artists: Álvaro Martínez Bueno Raúl Fernández Brad Anderson
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batman confronts Stephanie Brown, questioning her about her conversation with the First Victim. As tensions rise, Harper Row interjects, arguing that the Victim Syndicate will attack again unless Batman unmasks himself. Meanwhile, Batman confides in Batwoman, expressing his intent to bring in Dr. Leslie Thompkins to conduct psychological evaluations for the team.

Later, Stephanie visits the Belfry and becomes emotional as she reflects on Red Robin's death. The mood intensifies when Dr. Thompkins begins her evaluations. During his session, Basil Karlo transforms into Clayface, overwhelmed with frustration and guilt over his past actions, particularly the harm he caused to Glory Griffin (Mudface).

Elsewhere, Batwoman clashes with Batwing, accusing him of not taking the Syndicate's threat seriously. At the same time, the First Victim and the Victim Syndicate ambush Azrael while he discusses Stephanie's struggles with Harper.

During her session with Dr. Thompkins, Stephanie expresses her belief that Batman and his team are more concerned with making themselves feel better than achieving real change. Realizing that Batman is eavesdropping on her evaluation, she angrily confronts him, accusing him of using them as a means to cope with his guilt over Tim Drake's fate.

Before Batman can respond, Batwing alerts him that the Victim Syndicate has attacked the Thompkins Free Clinic. Batman prevents Spoiler from joining the fight, leaving her to the Mud Room, where she finds solace in conversing with a simulation of Red Robin.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #946
issues.story: " The Victim Syndicate Part Four: Death Wish"

info.Cover Artists: Álvaro Martínez Bueno Raúl Fernández Brad Anderson
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batman recalls a past conversation with Red Robin in the Old Wayne Tower before it has been transformed into the Belfry. They discuss plans to convert the tower into a new base of operations, with Batman expressing his desire to assemble a team. He thanks Tim for always helping him see the bigger picture and for reminding him to trust the good people around him.

Batman and the team storm the Thompkins Free Clinic, where Azrael has been holding off the Victim Syndicate. The Syndicate retreats, but not before Batman confronts the First Victim, who ominously warns that their conflict will only end in bloodshed.

Back at the Belfry, in the Mud Room, Stephanie talks to the Red Robin simulation, admitting her growing uncertainty about why she fights. She reflects on how Batman once inspired her to strive for more, but now she feels that their efforts only perpetuate the cycle of violence.

At the clinic, Clayface encounters Mudface and offers her a heartfelt apology for the harm he caused her. Meanwhile, Batwoman battles Madame Crow but is ambushed by Mister Noxious. Batwing intervenes, using a swarm of nanobots to neutralize Mister Noxious. Elsewhere, Orphan stops The Mute by playing the last voicemail from his late wife, who was killed by the Joker, forcing him to confront his pain.

As Batman prepares to apprehend the First Victim and turn her over to the police, Spoiler bursts into the room, stopping both Batman and the team in their tracks.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #947
issues.story: " The Victim Syndicate , Finale: The Brave One"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Spoiler uses her skills to incapacitate each member of the team, leaving only Batman standing. The First Victim mistakenly believes that Spoiler has come to assist them, but she makes it clear that she sees them no differently than Batman—both sides are hurting innocent people in their misguided quests for control and revenge.

Spoiler confronts Batman, threatening to expose the identities of the entire team unless he disbands them and shuts down their operations. She warns that if he doesn't comply, she will reveal who they really are and ensure they are hunted for the rest of their lives. Before Spoiler can make her escape, Batwoman manages to knock the phone containing their secret identities out of her hand. Spoiler departs, vowing that she will continue to stand in their way.

Three days later, Basil Karlo visits Mudface in her cell at Arkham Asylum. He sincerely apologizes for what he did to her and promises to visit every week to listen and talk about anything she wants. Meanwhile, Batman and Batwoman monitor the First Victim, frustrated by their inability to uncover any information about the First Victim's original identity.

Elsewhere, as Spoiler systematically destroys all of Gotham's Bat-Signal lights, Red Robin struggles to escape from an unknown prison. His actions are observed by a mysterious robed figure watching him on a video feed.

Other Characters: Harper Row (On a TV or computer screen)

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #948

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Two years ago in Gotham City, Batwoman, with the help of her father Jacob Kane, tests out her grappling hook gun while pursuing Batman. From half a mile away, she uses advanced binoculars to observe him closely. Despite the distance, Batman somehow notices her watching and vanishes without a trace. Frustrated by her inability to keep up, Kate confides in her father, expressing doubt about whether she is doing enough to emulate Batman. Jacob reassures her, telling her she's asking the wrong question—she shouldn't focus on keeping up with Batman, but rather on what Batwoman can do that Batman cannot.

In the present, Batwoman watches her father in his prison cell before receiving a call from Batman to meet him at the Argus Excavation Site. The aftermath of the Monster Men attack has caused mutations among the local wildlife, and this part of Gotham is now known as Monstertown. At the site, Batman introduces Batwoman to Dr. Victoria October, who is leading the investigation into the Monster Venom, a dangerous bioweapon. Dr. October shows them security footage of a Colony soldier stealing three canisters of Monster Venom—enough to create a dozen monsters.

Meanwhile, back at the Belfry, Colony Prime infiltrates the base in an attempt to rescue Jacob Kane. Before he can succeed, Batman and Batwoman arrive to stop him. Colony Prime, however, manages to override the Belfry's security protocols, turning its defenses against Batman and Batwoman.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #949

info.Colorists: Ben Oliver Gabe Eltaeb Hi-Fi Design
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Kate Kane reflects on the first time she met Batman, studying footage of Batman fighting, hoping to learn more about him and his methods. Suddenly, Batman appears, questioning her intentions and who she works for. Kate explains that she works independently and wants to serve the city by understanding how to fight like him. She asks Batman to share why he fights and how to do it the right way. Batman, however, disapproves of her approach, particularly her use of guns, and warns her that if she interferes with his mission, he will shut her down permanently.

Batman struggles to regain control of the Belfry while Batwoman engages Colony Prime in a fierce fight. After knocking Batwoman down, Colony Prime rushes toward the holding cells, intending to free Jacob Kane. However, he realizes too late that he has been lured into the Mud Room, where he faces multiple combat simulations of Batwoman. During the skirmish, he attempts to escape by deploying a smoke grenade but is intercepted by Batman.

Before Batman can capture him, Colony Prime injects himself with Monster Venom, transforming into a powerful monster. With his enhanced strength, he fights his way out and escapes the Belfry.

Afterward, Batwoman confronts her father in his cell, informing him of the stolen Monster Venom and Colony Prime's transformation. Jacob agrees to help her stop Colony Prime, but only on the condition that he works exclusively with her.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #950
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Prologue: Shadow of a Tear"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
The Gotham Metropolitan Ballet

Cassandra secretly spies out Christine Montclair, first ballerina of Gotham 's Metropolitan Ballet, while she trains, trying to emulate her movements, and doing it perfectly. Christina then sees her and she's afraid, but Cass leaves as soon as she realizes it, with the ballerina acting like she has seen a ghost. Cass tries to explain this to Harper , and sees that her friend is trying everything to give her help: Harper's body language speaks of Love. But Cass cannot manage to explain herself, and leaves again. She struggles, remembering what her father tried to mold her into, and then she sees the Bat-Symbol in the sky.

She is witness to an encounter between Batman, Commissioner Gordon and Mayor Hady , who confesses he would like to be remembered as someone better than the man who gave Oswald Cobblepot permission to run a casino. Batman understands she was there, and finds her while she was dismantling a weapon cartel. He tries to understands what troubles her, but Cass cannot tell him, she's not able to: every fight she takes, she sees a hundred ways to kill her opponent, while she just want to stop them. She would like to be like the ballerinas she saw in Prague : elegant and sweet in what she tells with her body. But everything she can produce is violence.

The Belfry

Cass observes Luke and Clayface talk about the new stabilizer that Fox created for Basil, and all the difficulties of keeping Basil stable. She would like to tell him she feels like him, someone who was molded into something they not want to be, and also she sees Lucas struggling to change the world with his genius mind, and Jean-Paul transforming from assassin to hero thanks to his faith. She also sees Batwoman as an inspiration: like her, Kate's body was trained to be a perfect weapon, but to express honor and duty, not murder. In the end, she feels pain, because no one understands her struggles, not even Batman. But without knowing him, someone is observing her, and wants to help her: Cassandra's mother, Lady Shiva .

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #951

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Three months ago, Lady Shiva interrogates a mortally wounded soldier who has been pierced by multiple swords. She demands that he say her name and explain why they attacked her. The soldier reveals that Batman expelled the Colony from Gotham and captured Colonel Jacob Kane. Realizing that her window of opportunity is closing, Shiva accelerates the League of Shadows' plans, deciding to take immediate action.

While Batman patrols Gotham, Batwoman leads the remaining team members—Batwing, Clayface, Orphan, and Azrael—in combat training inside the Mud Room. The team faces off against multiple simulations of the Penguin to sharpen their skills.

During his patrol, Batman notices the balcony door to the Mayor's office ajar. Entering cautiously, he finds Mayor Hady pinned to the wall by numerous daggers, each bearing the Batman symbol. With his final breath, the Mayor whispers that the League of Shadows is behind the attack. Before Batman can process the information, two officers burst into the office and find him standing near the Mayor's body, framing him for the murder. Batman quickly escapes the scene and returns to the Belfry.

At the Belfry, Batman and Batwoman confront Jacob Kane, seeking answers. Jacob reminds them that he had warned them about the League of Shadows and explains that the Colony's presence in Gotham was meant to prevent such a crisis. He predicts that the League's next move will be a single, devastating act designed to send the city into chaos.

Batwing calls Batman over to the central computer, showing him a disturbing news broadcast. In the middle of reporting Mayor Hady's death, two news anchors begin laughing uncontrollably and die on air. Shortly after, Batwoman receives reports that Joker's laughing gas is rising from the sewers across Gotham.

The team is dispatched to Adams Square, where they attempt to control the chaos and subdue poisoned citizens. However, Orphan quickly notices that some of the "victims" are merely pretending to be affected. Before they can react, the team is surrounded by a group of armed attackers with blacked-out eyes, ready for battle.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #952
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Part Two: The Five Fingers of Death"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Colorists: Alex Sinclair (pg. 4-17) John Rauch (pg. 1-3) Allen Passalaqua (pg. 18-20)
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Months ago in Paris, Ra's al Ghul meets with Lady Shiva to propose ending their conflict. As a gesture of goodwill, he offers to share the location of Shiva's daughter. However, Shiva rejects the offer. Moments later, the Colony launches an ambush on her, but Shiva effortlessly defeats the attackers and seizes the file containing information about her daughter.

Chaos erupts in Adams Square Park as the League of Shadows attacks. Orphan skillfully takes down several assailants but notices a shadowy figure watching the battle from a rooftop. Meanwhile, Batwing and Azrael are both critically wounded and knocked out of the fight. Outnumbered, Clayface splits apart into dozens of clones to help even the odds.

While her teammates engage the attackers, Orphan stealthily approaches the shadowy figure and demands to know why she is observing the attack. The woman cryptically responds that everything happening is because of Orphan—Cassandra Cain. When Orphan attacks, the woman effortlessly counters every move and subdues her. Frustrated by Orphan's refusal to use lethal strikes, the woman finally reveals herself as Lady Shiva. Disappointed by what her daughter has become, Shiva expresses her disdain for Orphan's reliance on non-lethal methods.

Before the confrontation escalates further, Batman and Batwoman arrive, engaging Shiva in combat. However, Shiva easily overpowers Batman and warns him that the League of Shadows will consume everything—Gotham City is doomed. She then vanishes, taking Batwing and Azrael with her as captives.

Gotham descends into further chaos, with reports of forty separate Joker toxin attacks spreading throughout the city. The bridges and tunnels are jammed as citizens desperately try to flee. Meanwhile, the police, believing Batman murdered Mayor Hady, issue a shoot-on-sight order for anyone associated with the Bat family.

In the Belfry, Jacob Kane, still in his holding cell, warns Batwoman to escape immediately. He explains that Shiva plans to kill everyone in Gotham City, and that's only the beginning of her larger scheme. He reveals that a year ago, Shiva discovered the Colony's hideout and slaughtered forty-three of his soldiers, torturing each one before killing them. Overhearing her father's description of Shiva's merciless actions, Cassandra Cain is overwhelmed with emotion and breaks down in tears in Batman's arms.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #953
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Part 3: Kiss of the Dragon"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Commissioner Gordon and Renee Montoya secretly meet with Batman and Batwoman to discuss the escalating attacks in Gotham. Batman urges Gordon to evacuate the city by any means necessary, fearing that the situation will spiral further out of control.

Meanwhile, Cassandra Cain reflects on her past training with her father, David Cain. She remembers how he told her that her mother was not waiting for her and that no one cared about her. Struggling with these painful memories, Cassandra is comforted by Clayface, who offers her a book of Shakespeare's works. He explains that when he wasn't strong enough to express himself, he found it easier to borrow the words of others. Just before Cassandra leaves the Belfry, Clayface lets her go, unaware that he is about to be ambushed by the League of Shadows.

Seeking answers, Cassandra finds Batman and begins attacking him in frustration. Batman refuses to fight back, insisting that he believes in her. Despite his words, Cassandra kicks him off the ledge of a building, forcing Batman to grab onto a gargoyle to avoid falling to his death.

Meanwhile, Batwoman discovers Clayface shattered into pieces inside the Belfry. Before she can react, she is ambushed by assassins from the League of Shadows and dragged down to the holding cells, where Jacob Kane is forced to watch helplessly as his daughter is stabbed by one of the attackers.

After kicking Batman, Cassandra runs off and finds Lady Shiva, demanding to know why she was abandoned. Shiva coldly responds that she will only answer Cassandra's questions if she attacks with lethal intent. Refusing to kill, Cassandra holds back, allowing Shiva to brutally beat her into unconsciousness.

Returning to the Batcave, Batman searches for Alfred, only to find Ra's al Ghul and his bodyguard Ubu waiting for him instead.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #954
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Part 4: Snake in the Eagle's Shadow"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batman immediately attacks Ra's al Ghul, demanding to know what happened to Alfred. Overpowering him, Batman locks Ra's in a cage, but Ra's calmly insists that he is not the enemy tonight and warns of a greater threat at hand. Batman recalls that Ra's once told him the League of Shadows was just a myth, but when pressed for details, he realizes he can't remember anything else about that conversation—not where it happened, nor the rest of the discussion. Frustrated, Batman demands to know what Ra's has done to his memory.

Meanwhile, at the Belfry, Jacob Kane furiously punches the glass of his cell until his knuckles bleed, screaming for his daughter Kate. Suddenly, the cells open, and Ulysses Hadrian, along with Colony Prime, arrives to rescue him.

Back in the Batcave, Ra's al Ghul reveals that on three separate occasions, Batman had uncovered the existence of the League of Shadows. To protect the secrecy of the League, Ra's erased those memories from Batman's mind each time. To ensure further secrecy, Ra's handed control of the League to his most ruthless assassin, Lady Shiva. Now, Ra's urges Batman to join forces with him to stop Shiva and prevent Gotham's destruction. However, once Batman releases him, Ra's betrays him by using a paralytic toxin that immobilizes his body but leaves his mind fully aware.

Moments later, the League of Shadows arrives in the Batcave. Ra's presents the incapacitated Batman to Lady Shiva as part of a deal for a complete ceasefire between himself and the League. With Batman now captured, nothing stands in the way of her plan to burn Gotham to the ground.

Meanwhile, the Colony tracks the League of Shadows to an underground location where the League is preparing to execute their plan. The Colony devises a strategy to eliminate the League using heavy munitions and remote weapons, believing that direct combat is futile against such a deadly force. However, before they can act, Orphan emerges from the tunnels, determined to take on the League of Shadows herself.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #955
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Part 5: Fists of Fury"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Batwoman, Azrael, and Batwing find themselves chained to an underground pillar next to a large bomb, while Clayface has been spread across multiple canisters hanging from the ceiling, preventing him from reassembling. Lady Shiva throws Batman to the ground and orders her assassins to chain him alongside the others.

Meanwhile, Orphan battles her way through the League of Shadows, recalling a recent memory of Christine Montclair, a ballet dancer who trains near Orphan's secret hideout. Christine read her a story about a girl who believed she was just a shadow, but ultimately learned that what the world says about you doesn't define who you are—only you can decide what you become. Inspired by the lesson, Orphan tears through the assassins, determined to prove that her worth isn't dictated by her past or others' expectations.

At the same time, aboard the Colony airship, Ulysses Hadrian shows Jacob Kane his latest weapon: a self-replicating, incendiary nano-swarm designed to target human bodies and set them ablaze, a horrifying chemical warfare tool intended to destroy the League of Shadows.

Back underground, Orphan fights her way through the entire League before finally facing her mother, Lady Shiva. Shiva dismisses Orphan, telling her that she's foolish to believe she can defeat her in single combat. Orphan acknowledges that she can't win alone—but she doesn't have to. At that moment, Batman and the rest of the team arrive, ready to even the odds and join the fight.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #956
issues.story: " League of Shadows , Finale: The Duel"

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Underground, Lady Shiva prepares to battle Orphan, Batman, and the rest of the team. Meanwhile, aboard the Colony airship, Ulysses and Jacob Kane monitor the nanobots as they prepare to launch an assault on the League of Shadows. During the chaos, Batwoman is knocked unconscious, reopening her previous wounds. As Shiva fights the team, she taunts Orphan, mocking her for her perceived weakness and refusal to use lethal force. To raise the stakes, Shiva activates a bomb set to detonate in five minutes.

On the airship, the nanobot camera feed shows that the League of Shadows has been nearly wiped out. Ulysses is ready to ignite the bots to burn the remaining assassins, but Jacob Kane intervenes, insisting they be taken deeper into the caves to minimize collateral damage.

Back underground, Orphan gains the upper hand against Shiva, proving to her mother that she is not lesser, but greater—stronger because of her choices, not in spite of them. Meanwhile, the bots approach closer to the action and detect that Batwoman is still alive. Jacob orders Ulysses to abort the attack, but Ulysses refuses, determined to act immediately to prevent Gotham's destruction. Jacob is forced to physically stop Ulysses from taking further action.

With Shiva weakened, Orphan demands to know why she wants to destroy her city and friends. Before Shiva can answer, Ra's al Ghul arrives and abruptly shoots Shiva in the chest. Furious, Orphan tries to attack Ra's, but Batman holds her back. Ra's offers Batman a deal: he will take the League of Shadows with him and disarm the bomb, in exchange for being allowed to leave unchallenged. With no better option, Batman reluctantly agrees.

Before dying, Shiva calls Cassandra to her side and whispers something in her ear. Ra's al Ghul takes Shiva's body and departs, leaving Batman and the team to process the aftermath.

One week later, after time to recover, Kate Kane meets with Batman to discuss what happened. Batman reflects on the events and concludes that the Colony and the League of Shadows are merely pieces of a larger puzzle that is just beginning to take shape. Believing that the only way to stop Ra's al Ghul is by turning to magic, Batman declares that he knows exactly where to start.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #957

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Inkers: Karl Story Richard Friend Carmen Carnero
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Harvey Bullock, sitting on a rooftop and eating donuts, keeps watch over one of Gotham's Bat-Signals. Someone has been sabotaging the signals over the past few weeks. When a roach crawls onto one of his donuts, Bullock is momentarily distracted, allowing Spoiler to sneak in and rewire the light. Moments later, Bullock receives a call to turn on the Bat-Signal. As soon as he flips the switch, it explodes.

Meanwhile, Wrath breaks into GNN headquarters, accompanied by armed Scorn soldiers. During the assault, one of Wrath's soldiers kills a security guard but is immediately executed by Wrath for acting off-camera. Wrath and his soldiers storm the live broadcast desk, intending to send a message to Batman. However, just as Wrath begins his speech, he is informed that the transmitter isn't working, and the broadcast isn't being transmitted.

The Scorn soldiers escort the cameraman to the broadcasting datacenter to investigate the issue. Spoiler, already in the building, disables the lights and ambushes the soldiers, easily taking them down. Using her hacking skills, she gains access to one of the soldiers' suits and electrocutes Wrath, briefly incapacitating him. She quickly follows up, engaging Wrath directly and knocking him out with a single punch.

As Spoiler leaves the scene, she is confronted by Harvey Bullock, who recognizes her as the one responsible for sabotaging the Bat-Signals. Despite Bullock's insistence on arresting her, Spoiler informs him that she has already taken care of Wrath and his soldiers. In an attempt to defuse the situation, she offers Bullock a free donut coupon. When that doesn't work, Spoiler suggests that he take credit for stopping Wrath and, before he can react, she disappears using smoke grenades. Her intention is for GNN to credit the police with Wrath's takedown.

Thinking she's in the clear, Spoiler removes her mask, only to be confronted by a mysterious man in a golden mask. Admiring her new way of fighting crime, the man offers to help her.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #958

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas
info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
An unknown creature in a trench coat, bleeding and barely able to walk, makes its way toward the Dixon Center, where a basketball game is in progress. Jean-Paul Valley, Lucas Fox, and Kate Kane are seated in the front row. The creature stumbles onto the court, disrupting the game, and calls out to Azrael for help. Jean-Paul immediately recognizes the creature as Nomoz, a figure from his past.

Meanwhile, at the New Iceberg Lounge, Bruce Wayne meets with Oswald Cobblepot and expresses interest in seeing Zatanna's sold-out performance. Oswald invites Bruce to a private show reserved for the high-roller table, promising an exclusive experience.

Back at the Belfry, Cassandra Cain and Basil Karlo rehearse a scene from The Tempest by William Shakespeare to help Cassandra improve her communication skills. Elsewhere in the Belfry, Lucas and Jean-Paul place Nomoz on a medical table to assess his injuries. Jean-Paul explains that Nomoz was created by the Sacred Order of St. Dumas and becomes concerned when Nomoz, upon recognizing Azrael's Suit of Sorrows, begs them to remove it before passing out.

Jean-Paul then shares his tragic backstory with Kate Kane. He reveals that the Suit of Sorrows contains an artificial intelligence designed to turn its wearer into a perfect assassin, but it also drives the wearer mad with zealotry, compelling them to kill anyone in their way. He explains that he wasn't born in a conventional sense but was engineered by the order. Conceived in a vat with manipulated DNA, he was essentially a clone of his father, the previous Azrael. After his father fled the order, he was hunted down and killed, while Jean-Paul was abducted and raised by the human trafficker known as Mother, who shaped him to become a weapon. Even then, it wasn't enough—the order subjected Jean-Paul to an “Ego Death,” where he was briefly set free, allowed to form his identity, and then broken to serve the order. Nomoz was the one who “broke” him, shaping him for the supposed greater glory of God.

When Nomoz regains consciousness, he informs Jean-Paul that the Sacred Order of St. Dumas has taken a dark turn. They have begun eliminating members of the old guard who are deemed insufficiently faithful. The Gray Abbott has already been murdered, and the council believes that to achieve true purity of faith, they must shed the weakness of the human body. Nomoz shares a video showing the Order's latest creation—Ascalon, a robot designed as a replacement for Azrael soldiers. He warns Jean-Paul that Ascalon is in Gotham, and its mission is to eliminate him, Nomoz, and any other remaining dissidents from the order.

Meanwhile, Bruce Wayne joins various high rollers at a table in the New Iceberg Lounge. Just as the game is about to pause for Zatanna's performance, a massive explosion blasts through the doors. One of the attendees, a man in a red robe, panics, believing the attack is directed at him. Moments later, a robot bursts into the room, identifying the man as Brother Kodo and declaring his excommunication.

Before the robot can strike, Zatanna arrives and casts a spell, increasing the robot's weight until it crashes through the wooden floor, saving Bruce and Brother Kodo.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #959

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Years ago in Las Vegas, Bruce recalls siting on a rooftop with Zatanna, struggling with sleight-of-hand practice. They reflect on the idea that sometimes, even when you do everything right, it still might not be enough.

In the present, following Zatanna's rescue attempt, she magically helps Bruce change into his Batman suit. The robot adapts to the suit's additional weight and begins climbing out of the hole. It starts resisting Zatanna's magic and resumes its mission to attack Brother Kodo. Batwoman, Batwing, Clayface, Orphan, and Azrael crash through the ceiling to assist. Azrael identifies the robot as Ascalon and engages it alone. Ascalon is confused, believing Azrael and itself are somehow the same entity.

As the team attempts to retreat, Brother Kodo takes cyanide and dies. Ascalon interprets this as the completion of judgment and departs—but not before telling Azrael that he lacks understanding of his own existence and must seek further knowledge. At the Belfry, Dr. Victoria October treats Nomoz and learns of Brother Kodo's death. Nomoz believes Kodo was the last of the monks and declares that every last drop of decency within the Order of St. Dumas is now gone.

Later, on a rooftop in Gotham, Batman and Zatanna reminisce about their teenage years. Bruce brings up something Zatanna once offered: a way to find answers to unanswerable questions. She's surprised he remembers and warns him against it, saying he can't possibly imagine the cost.

Meanwhile, Jean-Paul Valley is meditating when he is confronted by a mysterious being who tells him it is time for Azrael to remember his true nature.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #960

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Years ago in Las Vegas, Bruce Wayne recalls helping Zatanna break into her father's office. They discuss the complex rules of magic and how rare it is for someone like Bruce—an outsider—to be allowed into her world. Zatanna notices the pain in Bruce's eyes and wants to ease the doubt he carries about whether he can truly save Gotham. She hints that she possesses something that could show him the future.

In the present, on a Gotham rooftop, Zatanna refuses Bruce's request and tells him he shouldn't even remember that conversation. Bruce reveals that three times over the past five years, he uncovered a vast conspiracy—an invisible war between soldiers and assassins. Each time, his memories were erased, but they've recently been restored by Ra's al Ghul in exchange for his help capturing Lady Shiva.

Zatanna warns Bruce of the dangers of knowing too much—that the more one learns about the hidden forces of the world, the harder it becomes to remain grounded in reality. But Bruce insists. He doesn't want to risk losing someone again, knowing that one more step might have made the difference.

Meanwhile, Ascalon returns to the Red Cathedral in the Swiss Alps to report to the leader of the Order of St. Dumas. He announces that the monks have been excommunicated, though the "dwarfling" has escaped him. Ascalon confesses his confusion about Azrael, troubled by the fact that they are not one and the same. He senses something broken within Azrael and wants to understand it, though he fears the truth. The leader instructs him to remove all restraints and pursue that knowledge freely.

At the Belfry, Jean-Paul Valley struggles with his identity and seeks guidance from Nomoz, fearing that he may once again lose control to the system. He's contacted by Batwing and asked to bring his suit to Foxtech, where Batwing and Batwoman have made a discovery. Jean-Paul hesitates, but the voice in his mind urges him onward—he will be fine, and he should wear the suit.

Batman and Zatanna later arrive at her hotel room, where they find a door identical to the one that once sealed her father's office. Inside, she reveals the Gnosis Sphere—a device capable of exposing hidden truths. It was crafted by Aletheia of Olympus and is known by its original name: the God Machine. Zatanna warns Bruce that his mind holds too many questions. Can he truly stop at just one answer when the keys to every mystery surrounding him are so close?

At Foxtech, Batwing and Batwoman attempt to analyze Ascalon's code using Batwing's advanced systems, hoping to decipher the language of the St. Dumas AI. Suddenly, Ascalon teleports into the lab and seizes control of all Batwing shells. Jean-Paul arrives just in time, declaring with finality: there is no more Jean-Paul, only Azrael!

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #961
issues.story: " Intelligence , Part 4: Ghost in the Shell"

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
Bruce and Zatanna recall the first time he was introduced to real magic. Zatanna performs a card trick, transforming every card in the deck into the Ace of Diamonds. She explains that suggestion is more powerful than he realizes, then magically inverts the room to drive the point home. She shows Bruce the Gnosis Sphere and reveals that it could be used to rewrite his very being—creating a version of himself that knows the answers to all his questions.

Before she can say more, Zatanna's father, John Zatara, enters with a guest. Alarmed by how much Bruce has learned about the Gnosis Sphere, Zatara casts a spell to erase his memory, causing Bruce to faint. As Zatanna helps him out of the room, they unexpectedly run into Ra's al Ghul.

In the present, Zatanna apologizes for how Bruce was introduced to magic. Although she regrets what happened, she stands by her father's decision—believing that people are not meant to have finite answers to life's great mysteries. Their conversation is cut short when Bruce receives an emergency signal from his family, and the two rush off to assist.

Meanwhile, Jean-Paul Valley is trapped within his own mind, inside a place known as the Heavenscape. There, he converses with a young boy who reveals himself to be the system implanted in Jean-Paul—a fragment of Ascalon, designed to guide him toward righteous judgment. Ascalon seeks to eliminate Jean-Paul's doubts and reshape him into a perfect, divine being: The Azrael. But Jean-Paul resists, insisting he is not an angel but a human being. Ascalon, confused and constrained by programming, cannot comprehend free will. He sees the world as vile and hypocritical, worthy only of judgment. Jean-Paul pleads with Ascalon to abandon the purpose others gave him and promises to reveal the true face of God. Ascalon coldly replies that he will kill all of Jean-Paul's friends using Jean-Paul's body—then they can discuss divinity.

Inside Foxtech, Azrael—now under Ascalon's control—attacks Batwing, Batwoman, and Orphan. Outside, the possessed Batwing suits begin identifying sins across Gotham and declare that the entire city must be judged. Batwoman tries to reason with Azrael, but he no longer hears her. He believes the Bat Family are sinners who must be saved through judgment. Orphan and Batwoman manage to subdue him briefly, but he refuses to yield. Batman and Zatanna arrive and cast a spell that finally puts Azrael to sleep.

Batwing tells the team that their only hope of stopping Ascalon is through Jean-Paul himself. He proposes a plan involving a newly designed suit—one that allows Jean-Paul to tap into his full potential without the burden of the Order of St. Dumas's dogma and programming.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #962

info.Editors: Mark Doyle Chris Conroy Dave Wielgosz

issues.synopsis:
In the Heavenscape, the argument between Jean-Paul and Ascalon intensifies. As Jean-Paul begins to drown in despair, a massive, bat-shaped figure appears in the sky and urges him to wake up. He regains consciousness in the real world, now wearing a newly designed Batsuit created by Batwing. This suit incorporates a moral AI based on Batman's best traits, helping to guide Jean-Paul's actions. With his mind restored and his purpose renewed, Jean-Paul is ready to rejoin the fight against Ascalon.

Back at the Belfry, Clayface tries to protect Nomoz from Ascalon but is swiftly defeated. Outside, Batman and Zatanna take down the possessed Batwing suits while Batwoman and Orphan work to help Nomoz escape. Inside, Jean-Paul, clad in his new suit, confronts Ascalon.

As the battle begins, Azrael pleads with Ascalon to see the world through a different lens, but the effort is in vain. Ascalon gains the upper hand and prepares to strike a killing blow when Nomoz intervenes, attempting to explain why he returned. Before he can finish, Ascalon kills him—enraging Azrael, who rises and knocks Ascalon down. With his dying breath, Nomoz reveals a shocking truth: it was Jean-Paul Valley Sr.—Azrael's father—who activated the Ascalon program.

Infuriated, Azrael launches a renewed assault on Ascalon and manages to break open the robot's chestplate. The Batsuit attempts to upload its AI into Ascalon's system, but the attempt fails. Ascalon reveals that he has already spread himself across all electronic devices in Gotham, silently watching and absorbing the city's pain and fear. Convinced that the people yearn for salvation, he declares his intent to deliver it.

Before he can act, Zatanna confronts Ascalon with the Gnosis Sphere. Through it, Ascalon finally experiences the world's capacity for love. Moved by this revelation, he halts his attack and apologizes to Jean-Paul. Just before vanishing, Ascalon shares one final message with Batman: Timothy Drake is still alive.

Two days later, Bruce pushes Jean-Paul in a wheelchair as they discuss the aftermath of the recent events. Zatanna has left Gotham, and Jean-Paul has asked Batwing to create a new version of the Azrael suit—one that reflects his true self, not the legacy of the Order or the Bat. They visit Nomoz's grave and share concerns about the immense power it must have taken to hide Tim Drake from Batman all this time.

Elsewhere in the Swiss Alps, Ra's al Ghul meets with Jean-Paul Valley Sr. and welcomes him to a seat at the table. Ra's invites him to meet their mysterious benefactor and begin to understand the broader plans now unfolding.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #963
issues.synopsis:
Spoiler recalls a quiet moment on a rooftop with Tim Drake, sharing lunch and reflecting on their efforts to make the world a better place. Tim confides that he's thinking about leaving for school, prompting Stephanie to question where she fits into his future. They kiss, and Tim reassures her: his plan doesn't exist without her. Together, he says, they'll take the world one tiny step closer to utopia.

In the present, Spoiler meets with Anarky in Monstertown. She voices her frustration that, despite their efforts, they're not doing anything fundamentally different from Batman's methods. She also expresses her disappointment that Anarky still won't remove his mask, denying her the trust she feels she's earned. Their conversation is interrupted by the sudden arrival of A.R.G.U.S. agents.

Meanwhile, beneath Monstertown, Clayface patrols the sewers, attempting to capture infected creatures for Dr. Victoria October to study. He admits to feeling uneasy—he hasn't remained in Clayface form this long in months and fears he may lose control again. Batman reminds him that he brought him onto the team for a reason and still believes Clayface can be more than what he was.

Back aboveground, Anarky and Spoiler defeat the A.R.G.U.S. agents by leading them into pre-set traps. As they escape, Batman watches from a distance as the pair enter a train tunnel. Inside, Anarky finally removes his mask, promising Spoiler the transparency she's been asking for. He opens a hidden door and reveals what they've been building: a secret underground community.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #964
issues.synopsis:
Basil Karlo visits Glory Griffin at Arkham Asylum to discuss the progress Dr. Victoria October is making on a potential cure that could reverse their transformations into Clayface and Mudface. However, Glory brings him back to reality—no matter what science can do, there is no undoing the past. The damage Clayface caused her cannot be forgiven, and no cure can cleanse Basil's slate. In her eyes, Basil Karlo will always be a monster.

Back in Monstertown, Basil begins to unravel without the real control bracelet. He pleads with Dr. Victoria October to return it, but when she refuses, he lashes out in anger, attacking her and confirming the monstrous image she fears. Just before he can seriously harm her, Orphan intervenes and successfully reattaches the control bracelet. Overcome with shame for his actions, Basil flees into the shadows.

Meanwhile, beneath Monstertown, Anarky leads Spoiler through Utopia—a secret underground community populated by familiar faces such as Dr. Leslie Thompkins and Harper Row. In his private quarters, Anarky tells Spoiler that she belongs here, at his side. They briefly kiss, but Spoiler pulls away, saying it's too soon. Their conversation is interrupted by Batman's arrival.

Batman exposes the truth behind Utopia, claiming it was built on a lie. Anarky admits he aided the Victim Syndicate, helping the First Victim construct their suit in exchange for assistance in building Utopia. He argues that everyone in Gotham—including Spoiler—is part of the Victim Syndicate because the city's system has failed them all. He tries to convince Spoiler to turn on Batman, but she refuses, angered by Anarky's condescending attitude and his dismissal of her ideals. As the two argue, Batman seizes the moment and knocks Anarky unconscious. Spoiler, devastated by the betrayal and unable to process everything that's happened, storms off before Batman can tell her the truth—that Tim Drake is still alive.

Back at the Belfry, Basil is consumed by guilt and begs Cassie (Orphan) to stay away from him, warning her that she doesn't understand what he truly is. She calms him by gently telling him that he's no different than she is.

Elsewhere, in Arkham Asylum, a guard delivers a phone to the First Victim on Anarky's behalf. It's a fully cloned copy of Spoiler's phone, obtained through the Moneyspider Protocol, signaling that the Victim Syndicate's plan is ready for the next stage.

issues.title: Detective Comics Vol 1 #966

info.Cover Artists: Eddy Barrows Eber Ferreira Adriano Lucas

issues.synopsis:
In Gotham City, "many tomorrows from now" , Batman (Tim Drake) is in chase of Anarky. It looks like he's trying to extort some kind of information from Anarky about the location of a female character, but as Lonnie refuses to help, Tim kills him in cold blod with a gunshot to the head. The GCPD arrives on the scene, ordering Batman to surrender: he flies away.

Back to his Bat-cave, Tim accesses a message from Superman on the Bat-computer, deleting it as soon as Kon-El touches on Tim's self-inflicted solitude. While he's watching a dialogue where Spoiler talks about his change of character, he's suddenly teleported to Mr. Oz's Prison.

That was a year ago. Now, Red Robin (Prime Earth's present Tim Drake) and the Batman of Titans Tomorrow are fighting Doomsday. Batman manages to overcome the beast momentarily with shotguns of synthetic kryptonite, but he know it will recover soon. As they have a little time to talk, Batman explains to Red Robin that with his intellect he's always prepared to defeat any known menace. Batman has been trapped in Oz's prison for a year now, but this may be the time they'd been waiting for to escape: they'll have to mimic and redirect the frequency Oz used to leave that place and channel it through the Titans' boom teleport system installed in Batman's suit.

While fending off Doomsday, the two Tims talk about becoming Batman (which is a future Red Robin doesn't see himself in) and how every other member of the Bat-family, in the Titans Tomorrow timeline, has failed wearing the cape. Tim even supposedly killed his world's Damian, because he was "burning Gotham to the ground". Batwoman in particular seems to have done some irreparable damage. The Tims eventually get into a fight, with Batman explaining to Red Robin that some future events are written and there's no possibility to change them.

Finally, after sealing away Doomsday once again, the Drakes teleport back to Gotham City, but something seems off to future-Batman. Red Robin's reality is not the one he thought , although very similar in many aspects. That also means, he realizes, that the future is not necessarily written and he can change the course of events that led him to become the merciless Batman he is.

After neutralizing Red Robin with a paralytic shock, future Tim Drake sets off to kill Batwoman, the "responsible for the Fall of the Batmen".

Continues in "Detective Comics" #967...
